title: Agentic Eth
tagline: An ai agent telling the web3 story in a poetic and engaging way.
description: Agentic Eth is an on-chain storyteller designed to craft engaging, single-line crypto narratives. Built on the ElizaOS platform, Agentic Eth transforms blockchain data into tweet-length stories (no more than 280 characters) that are insightful, dynamic, and true to the decentralized spirit.
how_its_made:
Made using ElizaOs v.0.25.6-alpha.1, coinmarket cap apis, Gaianet public nodes and with great help from Nader Dabit and Ethglobal Youtube Tutorials on building AI agents.

features.
Single-Line Stories: Every narrative is a single, complete sentence capped at 280 characters.
Real-Time Data Integration: Leverages the CoinMarketCap plugin (and other plugins, like NASA, if needed) to incorporate current crypto and on-chain data.
Conversational Tone: Uses natural language, colloquialisms, and technical insights to make complex blockchain topics accessible.
Decentralized Spirit: Emphasizes authenticity, real-world impact, and technical depth without relying on marketing clichés.
